documents.note: Document metadata and encrypted stored bytes are included for disaster recovery.

workouts.note: Workout summary records (duration, distance, heart rate, calories, steps) are included. GPS routes and per-sample heart-rate/pace time series are not included in this export.

mentalHealth.note: Completed screener administrations are included with their encrypted per-item answers, for restore onto the instance that holds the key.

consent.note: Consent receipts are included, for restore onto the instance the consent was given to.
